label: Lab module
lead: Lab errors are usually process errors, not technique errors. The sample got mislabelled. The doctor wasn’t notified. The report didn’t reach the patient. Lucoze’s lab module fixes the process — with barcodes, role-based hand-offs, and a status feed everyone sees.

stats.label: Sample status visible at every station

rows.title: Barcode at collection. Visible at every station.
rows.lead: Collection → receiving → processing → verification → report. Each station scans, updates, hands off, so the doctor can see where the sample is without a phone call. Reports and patient updates are set up for your lab during onboarding.
bullets: Pre-printed barcodes or print-on-demand at collection.
Sample rejection workflow with reason codes — quality trends are visible.
Outsourced tests tracked alongside in-house — one report, one TAT.

rows.title: Reports the patient actually understands.
rows.lead: Doctor-friendly format on one side, patient-friendly format on the other. Reference ranges are flagged on the report, and the signing pathologist’s details sit on it. The lab can hand the PDF to the patient.
bullets: Audit trail — who signed, and when.
Report PDF the lab can print or share with the patient.

faqs.q: Does the lab module support NABL documentation?
faqs.a: Lucoze keeps an audit trail of who signed a report and when, which supports NABL documentation. Accreditation itself remains the lab’s responsibility, and the report layout is set up for your lab during onboarding.

faqs.q: Can we use it without a pathologist on site?
faqs.a: Yes — the outsource module routes samples to a contracted lab and records the report against the patient, so the front desk sees one report and one status.
